source_claim: AlphaEvolve-style critique and feedback channels should provide attributable model-review signal under explicit budget policy
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has configured reviewer specs, manifest-safe reviewer names, optional reviewer prompts, reviewer role labels, role backend routing compatibility, role budget accounting compatibility, a bounded synchronous reviewer pool, first-valid and last-valid aggregation, reviewer parser status, valid revision counts, selected reviewer provenance, reviewer elapsed seconds, reviewer outcome status, and inline runtime artifact policy. It does not claim async reviewer overlap, calibrated reviewer-score reports, reviewer reliability ablations, per-reviewer provider isolation, or external reviewer timeout artifacts.
